data.name: Awadil
data.gender_notes: Awadil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Awd', meaning 'to be heavy, powerful, or strong'. In Islamic history, Awadil refers to warriors who exhibit courage and strength in the face of adversity. The name Awadil carries the meaning “Powerful, Brave” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Awadil usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, brave and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of bravery and strength in the path of righteousness.
data.etymology: Awadil belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Powerful, Brave.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Awadil total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: عوضيل
in_arabic.meaning: عوضيل يعني الشخص الذي يعوض عن شيء أو شخص
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عوضيل مشتق من الجذر العربي 'عوض' الذي يعني التعويض أو الاستبدال. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم هذا الاسم للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يعوض عن شيء أو شخص آخر، وقد يكون له دلالات روحية و دينية في بعض السياقات الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: عوضیل
in_urdu.meaning: عوضیل کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو کسی چیز یا شخص کی جگہ لیتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: عوضیل نام عربی جڑ 'عوض' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے تعویض یا تبدیلی۔ اردو میں، یہ نام اس شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو کسی چیز یا شخص کی جگہ لیتا ہے، اور اس کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کی روایات میں ایک خاص ثقافتی اور روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: अवदिल
in_hindi.meaning: अवदिल का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति की जगह लेता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अवदिल नाम अरबी जड़ 'अवद' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है प्रतिस्थापन या बदलाव। हिंदी में, यह नाम उस व्यक्ति के लिए प्रयोग किया जाता है जो किसी चीज़ या व्यक्ति की जगह लेता है, और इसका उपयोग भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में एक विशेष सांस्कृतिक और आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: عوضيل
in_pashto.meaning: عوضيل دى هغه کس معنی چې د بل چا یا څيز بدله شي
in_pashto.long_meaning: عوضيل نوم د عربي ريښو 'عوض' څخه اخستل شوی دی چې د تعويض يا تبديل معنی ورکوي. په پښتو کې، دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کيږي چې د بل چا يا څيز بدله شي، او دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودونو کې ځانګړی کلتوري او مذهبي اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Awadil
in_english.meaning: Awadil means a person who replaces or compensates for something or someone
in_english.long_meaning: The name Awadil is derived from the Arabic root 'awd' which means to replace or compensate. In Islamic tradition, Awadil signifies a person who takes the place of another or makes up for a loss. The name carries spiritual connotations of selflessness and generosity, reflecting a personality trait of being supportive and substitutable.

historical_references.reference: The name Awadil is believed to have originated from the ancient Arabian city of Yathrib (later named Medina), where the Prophet Muhammad established the Islamic community in 622 AD. Awadil was one of the prominent tribes in Yathrib, and its members were known for their strong support of the Islamic cause and their hospitality to the Prophet and his companions.
historical_references.context: Early Islamic history, pre-caliphate era, formation of the Islamic community in Medina

historical_references.reference: Another reference to the name Awadil can be found in the works of the medieval Islamic historian Ibn Khaldun (1332-1404 AD). In his magnum opus, the 'Muqaddimah', Ibn Khaldun describes the Awadil as a Berber tribe that inhabited the region of Fez in Morocco during the medieval period. He notes that the Awadil were known for their military prowess and their role in defending the Islamic territories against Christian invasions from the north.
historical_references.context: Islamic history, military and defensive strategies during the medieval period
